title: MOM's: Coach MYR5 is here.
notes: One screen for today: protein, water and workout minutes against your goals.
Camera training walks you through each movement with a tutorial hologram, then counts your reps or time.
Rest between sets with a guided breathing countdown.
Take a photo of your food for AI suggestions — recognition runs on your phone, nothing is uploaded.
Log water in one tap, a workout in one tap, and re-log a recent meal in one tap.
Progress shows your streak, the last seven days and your weight trend.
Reminders for workouts, meals and water, even when the app is closed.
